crossRefs.note: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
He built Elath, and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.
At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to…
Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh, and brought him…
They brought him on horses, and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

people.name: Elath
